source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: قررنا نروح رحلة عالقدس مع الاصحاب.
sentences.en: We decided to take a trip to Jerusalem with our friends.

sentences.ar: ركبنا الباص الصبح والطريق كان مزدحم.
sentences.en: We took the bus in the morning and the road was crowded.
When we arrived, we walked through the old city.
The streets were narrow and full of shops.

sentences.ar: اشترينا حلويات وبهارات وريحة الكل حلوة.
sentences.en: We bought sweets and spices and everything smelled nice.
We sat drinking coffee and watching the people.

sentences.ar: زرنا أماكن قديمة وصورنا صور كتير.
sentences.en: We visited old places and took many pictures.
In the evening, we had falafel and hummus for dinner.

sentences.ar: رجعنا عالبيت متعبين بس اليوم كان بيستاهل.
sentences.en: We went home tired but the day was worth it.
